rationale: ⲡⲓ- demonstrative + ⲛⲁⲍⲧⲉ ('faith,' Lyc. ⲡⲛⲁⲍⲧⲉ in glossary). Here functions not as the abstract virtue 'faith' but as the specific item of teaching: 'the assurance/conviction that I taught you.' Renders the demonstrative-determined sense better than 'the faith.'
Lyc. ⲧⲉⲟⲩⲟ + 3sg.f object suffix -ⲥ̄ assimilated as -ⲁⲥ. Already in glossary as 'declare.' This entry documents the suffixed form.

Adversative-reiterative discourse-marker found in lines 24 of this kephalaion. Possibly compound of ⲇⲉ + ⲟⲛ or related. Functions as soft contrast linker between two classes (those who rejoice / those who grieve).
Compound: ϣⲃⲏⲣ ('fellow') + Greek συγγενής ('kinsman'). Standard Coptic-Greek hybrid for blood-relations. Used here for the newborn's natural kindred who rejoice at his birth.

Qualitative of ⲱⲡ 'count, reckon' + directional ⲁ-. Standard Coptic idiom for kinship/membership: 'reckoned to (a kindred),' 'belonging to (a kin).' Used twice in lines 25-26 to mark non-membership in the birth-family.
Lyc. ⲁⲟⲩⲏⲧ = ⲟⲩⲏⲧ 'single, joined, sole' (cf. accumulated ⲡⲁⲟⲩⲏⲧ 'the unity'). Here in possessive ⲁⲡϥ̄ⲁⲟⲩⲏⲧ 'to his single (kindred)' — the unified family-circle to which strangers do not belong.
